practices.summary: Start traversals from a selective bound (id, label+property) rather than g.V().
Variable-length patterns ([*] / repeat()) should carry an explicit depth bound.
Edge labels should name the domain relationship; generic labels obscure intent.
Vertices with very high edge fan-out (supernodes) dominate traversal cost - a static signal is a candidate, not a confirmed hotspot.
Neptune bulk load: CSV (~id/~from/~to/~label columns) for property graphs, RDF serializations for RDF.
